projects.title: Wildside
projects.oneLiner: A painted nature game that turns real places into living, explorable worlds — ecology, weather and wildlife rendered in a hand-painted style in the browser.
projects.scope: Browser build; the painted view targets WebGPU with a WebGL fallback.

projects.title: Hamon Engine
projects.oneLiner: A Rust + wgpu game engine built for agent control: typed ECS commands, deterministic replay, native and browser targets.

projects.title: afterimage
projects.oneLiner: Hand it scraps — a blurry clip, a few photos, a partial log — and it reconstructs what most likely happened, then tells you which single observation would settle the rest.

projects.title: Replay Forge
projects.oneLiner: Rebuilds a real basketball play in 3D from game footage, then lets you branch the replay and ask what-if — every frame tied back to source video.

projects.title: chronos-vision
projects.oneLiner: Watches ordinary video and forecasts where every object in the scene is going next — and which constraints will change.

projects.title: Spire of Octaves
projects.oneLiner: A vertical world of cities stacked on cities — go down to be born, go up to be remembered. Thirty-seven free stories across nine heights of the Spire, from the boiler-row Clans of Geargrave to the brine courts of the Salt Scriptoria, plus serials, a short novel on Royal Road, and a game in progress on the Hamon Engine.

projects.title: mechanism
projects.oneLiner: Recovers the joints, linkages and working dynamics of real machinery from nothing but a video of it moving.

projects.title: Phantom Window
projects.oneLiner: Turns flat phone video into a window you can look around: estimated depth, tracked camera, cinematic parallax and novel views.

projects.title: Captionverse
projects.oneLiner: Captions placed in space beside whoever is speaking, with directional sound cues — accessibility that tells you who and where, not just what.

projects.title: Domino
projects.oneLiner: A causal digital twin for smart-home automations: reconstruct event chains, expose rule conflicts and timing races, and prove fixes by replay.

projects.title: synapse
projects.oneLiner: Walk around inside a live, running software system in XR — see processes and data move, reach in and change them.

projects.title: materialtruth
projects.oneLiner: Lights a part from many controlled angles and reads the surface back, catching scratches and defects a single photo misses.

projects.title: Hamon model research
projects.oneLiner: Agents running real experiments on new model architectures, representations and learning algorithms designed for clusters from the start.

projects.title: TasteTable
projects.oneLiner: Agentic weekly dining and outing planner for seniors and caregivers, grounded in Qloo taste signals.

projects.title: Ledgerly
projects.oneLiner: Agentic invoice and payout copilot for freelancers with a human approval gate.

projects.title: RecallWeave
projects.oneLiner: Browser-only adaptive learning toolkit: transparent Bayesian learner, interactive labs, lesson authoring.

projects.title: Pneumatic MRI sim
projects.oneLiner: A deterministic Rust simulation of the control stack for an air-driven surgical robot that works inside an MRI scanner.

projects.title: TowerOps
projects.oneLiner: An air-traffic-control conflict-awareness demo where bounded AI agents flag converging aircraft on a live radar view — built in a weekend with Strands Agents.

projects.title: Hamon memory research
projects.oneLiner: How should an agent decide what to remember, revise or forget? Working prototypes, Python with a Rust core.

projects.title: Surgical ergonomics
projects.oneLiner: Tracking surgeons' posture, muscle load and heart rate during procedures, with a realtime demo — built for the Soangra Lab at UCI.

projects.title: Threshold
projects.oneLiner: A doorbell that works for people who can't easily hear, see or reach the door: who's there, what they want, and a way to answer.

projects.title: Familiar Memories
projects.oneLiner: When a relative visits, it recognizes them and brings up the photos you share — with consent and revocation built in, for families living with memory loss.

projects.title: ScopeSignal
projects.oneLiner: Evidence-backed milestone checkout with deterministic PayPal Sandbox replay.

projects.title: workflow-checks
projects.oneLiner: Evidence-first back-office checks on synthetic data: freight detention, invoice audit, PT authorization, utility exceptions.

projects.title: CaptureSuite
projects.oneLiner: Windows-first multimodal research capture: daemon, versioned worker plugins, sealed sessions, PySide6 operator UI.

projects.title: CanvasPilot
projects.oneLiner: Agentic Canvas LMS tooling: MCP + CLI, a stay-open SSO session broker, structured Canvas REST tools.

projects.title: testpilot
projects.oneLiner: Give it a code change; it writes the regression tests, runs them, and fixes the ones that break. Nebius × NVIDIA hackathon entry.

links.hackathon: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon

projects.title: Wild Neighbors
projects.oneLiner: Turn the nature around someone's home into a living place they can visit, recognize, and care about.
projects.scope: Product seed: direction is set; no implemented features or live build yet.
